context: Hina and Sho name autumn fruits.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、秋の果物、いっぱい。
lines.en: Sho, look — there are so many autumn fruits!
lines.style: Bright, clear opening with genuine delight. High child register. Quick pace on 'look,' then a soft breath before the reveal. Real warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, observant. Small voice with a gentle pointing gesture in the words. Soft, steady pace. A moment of genuine wonder mixed with small-child certainty.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright affirmation with a little lift on the opening. Still high, still child-voiced, but softer and more personal. No rush — letting the 'I like' land genuinely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: They're so delicious this season, aren't they?
lines.style: Small, thoughtful voice. Slow pace. A six-year-old noticing something true about the world — not precocious, just real. Soft trailing confirmation at the end.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Warm, open finale. Bright but not rushed. A child settling into genuine happiness about sharing. Soft emphasis on 'together.' Real tenderness underneath the brightness.
